findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Limits.pettyCashCeiling matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: numeric literal 250.00 (line 6): value 250.00 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Rules.priceTolerance matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 0.04 (line 8): value 0.04 = DEC-PR05.p1 (superseded by DEC-PR07, same form) and no accepted parameter has the same form. The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Accounts Payable: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
